notes.title: New Version of Game Demo Released!
notes.notes:
We are excited to share that a new version of the game demo is now available!



The original demo was uploaded at the time of the game’s launch and has not been updated to incorporate the latest changes. The new demo version mirrors the full game but is limited to the first seven puzzles.



We invite you to explore this updated demo before making a purchase to see if the game suits your preferences.



Happy puzzling!
~ Digital Jigsaw Puzzle Team

notes.title: New Update Released: Even more custom puzzles than before!
notes.notes:
Greetings,



A major update has been released for Digital Jigsaw Puzzle.



The overall menus of the game have been updated. The options menu has been split into tabs to reduce clutter.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32921865/09db2abf078893f90d58656ddb0aa3c405abc86b.png"]



The previous 4 custom puzzle slots have been expanded to 10 slots. You can now have even more photos of your pets now!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32921865/1735bf1d1650e71cc1d0db513370c78eb6cbc6ac.png"]

Several new hotkeys have been added to the game. Want to see the puzzle image without having to click the "View Image" button? Just hit the 'V' key now. (Full list is in option menu.)



The option settings has been updated to support Steam Cloud Saves. You may see your option settings reset when first launching this update. Just select your settings back again. Your puzzle progress is untouched.



Steam cloud not for you? That is okay. You can turn it off for this specific game in the Steam game properties.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32921865/6f5a2d3ec2731ee07236a8dcc454a25b09e5c111.png"]

Note:

This update was attempted to be released with minimal issues. Sometimes some things get missed. If something is not working properly please leave a note on the discussion forums. 

You can roll back to the previous release by selecting the 'previousbuild' beta. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32921865/5b03a189c8c3b5e5b346e8085332c88284b6ee92.png"]

Thanks for the continued support,

Digital Jigsaw Puzzle

notes.title: Version 1.99 Spanish Localization and Sound Update
notes.notes:
Digital Jigsaw Puzzle now supports the Spanish language. 

Right click "Digital Jigsaw Puzzle" in your library and select properties. The language tab will allow you select the Spanish language now.

Special thanks to Cautare from Reddit for helping with the translation.

Sound Effect Update 
The sound effect has been updated to play a different sound when two pieces connect. This change was made to help a player identify better when two pieces connect.

Note on all updates:
All previous game versions are kept as Beta branches under the game properties. If a bug has been released by mistake please post in the discussion forums to let me know. In the meantime you can roll back to continue playing.

notes.title: Version 1.98 - Table Mode (Far Right) and Table Mode (Even)
notes.notes:
Version 1.98 - Table Mode (Far Right) and Table Mode (Even)

The original mode "Table Mode" has been renamed to "Table Mode (Even)". This mode will spread the puzzle pieces evenly onto the screen.

Some people have not liked the lack of empty or open space. Therefore a new mode has been added called "Table Mode (Right)" which will condense the initial placements of the pieces on the right side of the screen.

notes.title: Update 1.9 - Custom Background Colors
notes.notes:
Custom Background Color

-Added a custom background color option. The color can be set by selecting the color from the chart. The setup should allow for any color you want.

New Rectangular Puzzles

-Added in new puzzles unique for the 28x20 puzzle size. The puzzles are optimized for the rectangular shape of the 28x20 puzzle.

 Option Menu Redesigned 

- The option menu was updated and cleaned up.

- Text was added to explain each game mode when selected.

- A sample image was added to preview the selected puzzle size.

 Custom Puzzles 

- The default custom image was updated. 

- Wording in the custom image instruction file was updated to no longer state a specific resolution is required on the custom image

 New Default Backgrounds 

- The default background options have changed.

 Scroll Mode - Keyboard 

- The boxes in scroll mode now can be swapped using the left and right keyboard keys. (Previously only the right mouse button would increment it)

 Puzzle Complete Screen Updated 

- The sparkles in the puzzle compete screen was updated to include a tiny jigsaw puzzle piece. 

- Sparkles altered to be unique on the Candy Corn puzzle (tab 10) and winter themed puzzles (starting on tab 11)

- The puzzle keeps displaying the jigsaw pieces at the end (instead of swapping to final clean image like before)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/98701c61c20999757f793ccdde85d5ea5546623c.jpg

notes.title: Update 1.8 - Puzzle Template Updated
notes.notes:
Puzzle Templates for 16, 64, 256, and 576 Pieces Updated 
- Updated the puzzle templates to a cleaner design

Custom Puzzle Load Time
- Custom puzzles load much faster now.

Highlight Edge button
- Added highlight edge button. It highlights pieces on the outer perimeter. Helpful if you wish to build the outer perimeter first and work inwards on a puzzle.

 Save File Update 
- Stored the game resolution in the save file. The game will open in the same resolution you closed it.
- Updated save file to contain piece join data.
- Compressed save files to compensate for additional data. 
- Old save files will convert automatically the next time the save is loaded automatically.
- New save files load much faster 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/c7f0c56534b96131d5bb50e9e47e061d56218ed7.jpg

notes.title: Update 1.7 - Scroll Mode Updated, Zoom Feature, and Extended Save Options
notes.notes:
Update 1.7 Release Notes:

Scroll mode changes: 
The concept is the same but now with a "box" to hold the pieces. Text added to state the current box out of the total boxes.

All puzzles save now:
Expanded the puzzle saves to create a save per puzzle variation. Changing the piece count, piece size, or puzzle mode is a different puzzle variation. (Anything that triggered a new puzzle in the current game) 

Reset button:
Added a reset button to reset a puzzle if you completed it and want to go again. Otherwise you will always load your previous puzzle.

Dynamic Piece Size:
The middle mouse wheel will change the piece size dynamically. The puzzle will save the setting. There is no change to the small and large piece settings. These settings still start the puzzle in the "small" and "large" pieces however you can override them as you feel it is needed.

Digital Background:
One new background was added in the digital theme.

notes.title: Update 1.5 - Additional Game Stat Tracking
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/1bf8ec427e8493308f5d19a6994b57120539ecc5.jpg

Digital Jigsaw Puzzle now tracks the completion of each jigsaw puzzle and the associated puzzle size upon completion. A medal is rewarded upon puzzle completion based on the puzzle size. The highest medal is displayed on the puzzle preview screen.


 A bronze medal is rewarded for 16 pieces completed.
 A silver medal is rewarded for 64 pieces completed.
 A gold medal is rewarded for 256 pieces completed. 


A new achievement was added for the completion of a 256 piece puzzle. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/e92c536a48ba53cf8a894191e03de8f47e1800bf.png

Notes:


 The piece count was not tracked before this update. It not possible to retroactively reward the medals.
 The custom puzzle does not count towards achievements or have a medal rewarded upon completion.

notes.title: Update 1.4 - Image Preview and Winter Puzzles Added
notes.notes:
Update 1.4 

New Features! 


 Eight new winter themed puzzles have been added
 Added view image button to see an image of the final puzzle being solved
 Under the hood changes to make puzzle pieces connect more precisely. 
 Digital Jigsaw Puzzle is currently 75% off through the Steam Winter Sale!


Bug fixes


 Fixed abnormal puzzle joins that were occurring.
 Added the "tab" of the slider mode to the save file. The game did not know what tab it was on when loading the saved puzzle.
 Added in a check to move any out of bound pieces back into the viewing screen when loading a puzzle. (Should not be seeing pieces go out of bounds - this is in case something breaks)
 Reduced puzzle load time (more noticeable for large near complete puzzles)
 Leave me a note below or in the discussion forums if something isn't working.

notes.title: Update 1.3 - New arrangement mode called the Swimming Pool!
notes.notes:
Introducing the new arrangment mode called - Swimming Pool!

This arrangement mode is perfect for those of you needing a big clear area to start your puzzle. The pieces in this mode will float like in water on the left and right sides of the screen. The pieces will slowly rotate around to give you optimal view of all the pieces while maintaining a small area. This arrangement mode will be the third variation available in addition to the table and scroll modes. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/e6566adb161d69ce3d2f97cf8204bb83f12154a8.png

This update will be free to Digital Jigsaw Puzzle. All puzzles, updates, and future contents are always free and are included in the base game.

Don't have the game? There is a special discount on the full game for one week! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921865/fd9fd6d4a79077ec10644fb33b19a097c5e37ad4.png

Additional bug fix: 
- Fixed case where achievements were unlocking under wrong conditions.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
- Puzzles will now save after every time a piece is connected. The save will reload after closing the game as long as the same puzzle is selected. The save is cleared if another puzzle is selected or an option menu selection is changed.

- The option menu will now save between sessions. You will always start the game in the same mode, number of pieces, and same background color.

- Fixed issue with initial placement of puzzle pieces. The layout should be more elegant now.

- Added hot key for full screen mode (F11 Key). 

Known Bug:
The fullscreen mode may need to be activated twice in a row.
